findings.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
findings.trigger: arraySize is multiplied by sizeof(int) to calculate the total memory allocation. If arraySize is very large, this multiplication could overflow, leading to an allocation of less memory than intended.
findings.assumptions: The value of arraySize is not checked for overflow before being used to allocate memory. The sizeof(int) is assumed to be less than or equal to the size_t range.
